title: Global constructibility from affine-local constructibility
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning that it admits a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring. Choose either the small étale site or the small pro-étale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of modules over the constant ring sheaf $\underline R_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an immersion $i:Z\to X$, write $F|_Z=i^{-1}F$ with constant coefficients [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Say that this restriction is locally constant with finitely presented values if it has a covering on the chosen site of $Z$ on each member $V$ of which it is isomorphic to the constant module sheaf $\underline M_V$, for some finitely presented $R$-module $M$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. The module $M$ may vary with $V$ and need not be finite as a set.

The following conditions are equivalent: (i) for every affine open $U\subseteq X$, there is a finite stratification $U=\coprod_a Z_a$ [def-constructible-stratification] by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset], such that each $F|_{Z_a}$ is locally constant with finitely presented values; (ii) there is one finite stratification $X=\coprod_b S_b$ by constructible locally closed subschemes such that each $F|_{S_b}$ is locally constant with finitely presented values. The equivalence holds separately for either choice of site, with no finiteness assumption on the underlying set of $R$.

source.place: Tag 095E, lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated, Noetherian module version and finite-refinement proof. The same partition/refinement argument applies to pro-étale module sheaves (proetale.tex, definition-constructible); Noetherian-space constructibility is Tag 005L, topology-lemma-constructible-Noetherian-space.

proof.text: Use the compact-space field of IsNoetherian X and quasi-separatedness of locally Noetherian schemes. This supplies the hypotheses of exists_global_stratification_factoring_local directly; there is no need to rebuild Noetherianity using a finite affine cover.

For either coefficient-sized site, the base-change functor is continuous and preserves finite limits, by the existing continuity instance and the finite-limit-preserving AsSmall equivalences and scheme base change. Apply lem-sfb-coefficient-finite-local-systems-pullback. Explicitly construct the coefficient-sized base-change composition isomorphism from MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp and take mates of the continuous pushforward composition isomorphism. Thus the property of the pullback of F being locally constant with finitely generated module values is stable under precomposition by any scheme morphism. For pro-etale local models, finite generation is equivalent to finite presentation over the Noetherian coefficient ring, by Module.finitePresentation_of_finite and its converse instance.

Prove a geometric statement for any predicate P on scheme morphisms into X stable under precomposition. Under affine locality choose an affine neighborhood and a witnessing partition for every point. Compactness gives a finite subcover. Reindex by Fin and apply exists_global_stratification_factoring_local. For each output stratum use its actual factorization morphism and stability of P. For the etale affine-local predicate, explicitly add its supplied constructibility proofs to FiniteLocallyClosedStratification to obtain the upstream Stratification, preserving every stratum, domain and immersion. The finite subcover and partition may be empty.

Conversely pull the global Stratification back along the inclusion of an arbitrary affine open using Stratification.pullback. Constructibility is a field of this structure. Apply stability of P along the first projection and the pullback condition. For the etale affine-local predicate, explicitly forget only the constructibility field to obtain FiniteLocallyClosedStratification and retain that proof as the separately required conjunct. Apply the geometric equivalence to the two local-system predicates from step 2; finite generation and finite presentation agree over the Noetherian ring.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_noetherian_global_constructibility
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (R : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (F : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Mod
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
        R)) :
    IsCoefficientConstructibleEtaleModule X R F ↔
      ∃ S : Stratification X,
        (∀ a : Fin S.n, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum a)) ∧
        ∀ a : Fin S.n, IsCoefficientModelLocallyConstantFinite
          (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} (S.domain a)) R
          ((coefficientEtaleFixedPullback.{u, v} (S.immersion a) R).obj
            ((coefficientModelFixedScalars _ R).obj F))
